title: Affect-Effect Primitive Distinction Projection
purpose: Define A|E as the primitive affect/effect distinction condition in its own domain and D(*|*) as the formal distinction-schema projection of that condition.

motivation.problem: The framework already governs the primitive distinction form, dominant-domain realization, and RT calculus chain, but the affect/effect-domain projection from A|E to D(*|*) remains implicit.
motivation.resolution: A|E is governed as the primitive affect/effect distinction condition and D(*|*) is registered as its formal distinction-schema projection without altering the meta-domain bindings or the canonical RT core.

core_definition.A_E: A|E is the primitive affect/effect distinction condition.
core_definition.D_star_star: D(*|*) is the formal distinction-schema projection of A|E.
core_definition.trace_requirement: Every D(*|*) projection must constructively trace to A|E and remain domain-bound.

projection_rule.reading: The primitive affect/effect distinction condition projects into formal distinction notation as D(*|*).

governance_rules.name: Domain Separation
governance_rules.statement: A|E is not the meta-domain A_meta/B_meta binding.

governance_rules.name: Affect-Effect Scope
governance_rules.statement: A|E belongs to the affect/effect domain.

governance_rules.name: Projected Schema Not Detached Primitive
governance_rules.statement: D(*|*) is projected from A|E, not independently primitive as a detached object.

governance_rules.name: Whole-Expression Schema
governance_rules.statement: D(*|*) remains a whole-expression schema and must not be decomposed into independent primitive parts.

effects: Registers A|E as a domain-local primitive distinction condition.
Treats D(*|*) as a formal projection of A|E rather than a detached primitive object.
Preserves the existing RT core and meta-domain binding separation.

notes: The canonical RT expression remains unchanged.
The meta-domain A_meta/B_meta bindings remain reserved for Memory Tensor RT.
The zero-state D(*|*) shorthand elsewhere in the textbook remains a separate governed reading.
A|E is governed within the affect/effect domain and remains distinct from the Memory Tensor meta-domain binding.
D(*|*) is a projected whole-expression schema and not a decomposed primitive object.
This patch is governance and architecture only.
The projection rule is domain-local and does not alter the canonical RT core or the primitive form governance.
